%
%  TABLE SIZING. All tables are set at \scriptsize with \tabcolsep 3pt and
%  are shrunk only when they still overflow, so the type is the same size
%  everywhere. The width of these tables is driven by the column count, not
%  by the font, so the wide ones are rotated (sidewaystable, 650pt of room
%  instead of 470pt) rather than scaled down. Only Tables 3 and 5 are still
%  reduced, by about 6%. A rotated float cannot be pinned with [H], so each
%  sidewaystable is followed by \clearpage to keep the floats in order.
%======================================================================
